query FlxCommerceSettings {
  flxCommerceSettings {
    paidStatuses
    excludeDonations
    lowStock
    hideCompany
    hideAddress2
    virtualNoAddress
    orderNotes
    stickyPay
    freeShipBar
    freeShipAmount
    receiptMaxMb
    receiptNotify
    deferToDonate
    cancelAfterDays
    feed
    feedBrand
    feedUrl
    notifyCustomerWa
    notifyAdminPhone
    notifyAdminOrder
    subRenewDays
    subGraceDays
    hiddenRedirect
    cardProviders
    whatsappReady
    donateCart
    donateHavale
    orderStatuses {
      slug
      label
    }
    freeShipThreshold {
      ...FlxCommerceMoney
    }
  }
  flxCommerceBankSettings {
    enabled
    title
    description
    holder
    iban
    bank
    refFormat
    refPrefix
  }
  flxCommerceRenewalStatus {
    ran
    at {
      ...FlxCommerceWhen
    }
  }
}

fragment FlxCommerceMoney on FlxMoney {
  amount
  currency
  formatted
}

fragment FlxCommerceWhen on FlxDateTime {
  iso
  timestamp
  label
  relative
}
